name: Minaret of Jam
heritage: part of UNESCO World Heritage Site
text: The Minaret of Jam (Pashto: د جام منار, Dari: منار جام) is a UNESCO World Heritage Site in western Afghanistan. It is located in a remote and nearly inaccessible region of Shahrak District, Ghor Province, between the Jam and Hari Rivers. The 62 m (203 ft) or 65 m (213 ft) high minaret was built c.

depictions.name: Minaret of Jam
depictions.text: The Minaret of Jam is an unconstructible building in Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Dynasties of India. It is purely decorative and has no actual use in-game, and is only available in the Scenario Editor.
